scope: Post-refactor audit: 18 user skills plus 3 maintainer skills

classification_rules.native: No identified external source relationship beyond local repository authorship.
classification_rules.reference: External source influenced concepts or workflow, but no upstream file is stored in this repository as part of this classification.
classification_rules.adapted: Upstream file or substantial text is translated, restructured, or modified.
classification_rules.unknown: Evidence is insufficient; do not assume redistribution rights.

skills.name: code-comment
skills.evidence: No external upstream hit identified in current text scan.

skills.name: commit
skills.evidence: SKILL.md explicitly uses Conventional Commits rules, but no specification text is vendored.

skills.name: context-doc
skills.evidence: Phase 2 converted context output to AGENTS.md canonical plus CLAUDE.md @AGENTS.md bridge using official documentation concepts.

skills.name: create-prototype
skills.evidence: Prototype generation uses local workflow contracts while referencing OpenAI product-design and gstack design-html concepts; no upstream file import is recorded.

skills.name: design-doc
skills.evidence: Planning and interview workflow is conceptually similar to Superpowers/gstack planning workflows; local template is not marked as upstream import.

skills.name: design-prototype-docs
skills.evidence: Screen/prototype planning concepts reference OpenAI product-design and gstack design planning only; no upstream file is imported.

skills.name: doc-audit
skills.evidence: Document drift verification references the official Codex and Claude context contracts; no external file content is imported.

skills.name: frontend-design
skills.evidence: The local production-UI workflow is a translated and substantially restructured derivative of Anthropic Skills frontend-design, with additional harness routing, validation, and platform-neutral rules. OpenAI product-design remains reference-only.

skills.name: git-scoped-account
skills.evidence: Local operational Git-account workflow.

skills.name: harness-bootstrap
skills.evidence: Combines a local scan workflow with official AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md context contracts.

skills.name: harness-setup
skills.evidence: Project context setup follows AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md import docs; templates are local.

skills.name: humanize-korean
skills.evidence: Phase 4 accepted im-not-ai v2.3.0 as an adapted source. Local files preserve concepts, safety contracts, MIT notice, and deterministic guard behavior without vendoring upstream runtime scripts.

skills.name: impl-doc
skills.evidence: Implementation planning resembles external plan/execution workflows, but file content is local.

skills.name: impl-fe-be-doc
skills.evidence: FE/BE phase planning and review gates are reference-only.

skills.name: impl-reuse-scan
skills.evidence: The local discovery-and-approval workflow is original; only existing-pattern and search-before-building concepts are limited references.

skills.name: impl-verify
skills.evidence: Fresh-evidence verification references Superpowers completion discipline and gstack qa-only report semantics without importing auto-fix runtime.

skills.name: multi-review
skills.evidence: Multi-perspective review concepts are reference-only.

skills.name: pre-commit
skills.evidence: Pre-completion verification/checking workflow is reference-only; local scan.sh is not marked imported.

skills.name: custom-skill-design
skills.evidence: The manager-only workflow remains an adapted derivative of Anthropic Skills skill-creator. OpenAI Codex skill-creator and Superpowers are reference-only concept sources with no imported files or internal helper scripts.

skills.name: harness-plugin-maintainer
skills.evidence: Phase 6 implementation. Local deterministic plugin build, validation, manager projection, and release-candidate metadata tooling.

skills.name: skill-portfolio-maintainer
skills.evidence: Phase 5 implementation. Local upstream check, discovery, staging, approval-gated promote, rollback, and eval tooling.
